div.div: رَصَدِىٌّ One who lies in wait for men in the way, to take their property unjustly; (Msb;) syn. with the Pers. رَاهْدَارْ; and so ↓ رَصَّادٌ . (Meyd, accord. to Golius [who, however, explains the Pers. word as meaning viæ custos, et vectigalium pro transitu exactor; which I do not think to be here intended thereby].)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
